name: Saeid Rezaeisadrabadi
bio:
I'm a Senior Mobile Engineer with over 8 years of experience architecting, developing, and maintaining complex mobile applications at scale. I specialize in performance optimization and build tooling with deep, hands-on expertise taking production apps through the full software development lifecycle.
A self-described build tools geek, I care deeply about writing clean, maintainable, and performant code, with a strong commitment to user privacy and secure, user-centric experiences. I bring that same discipline to the systems and pipelines that power mobile development at enterprise scale.
Beyond engineering, I'm a dedicated mentor and collaborative team player who actively contributes to high-impact technical decisions. I thrive at the intersection of deep technical craft and team growth, always expanding my knowledge and pushing the boundaries of what great mobile engineering looks like.
